description: Add a bounded 'JOURNEY / 10-YEAR STORY' section to the chatbot context so a visitor asking about the committee's decade journey (hamari yatra / 10-year / decade / since 2017) gets a real, data-grounded answer instead of the model improvising. Source it from the already-cached portalData payload: (a) real journey content when present — journeyEntries [{year, title_en, title_hi, content_en, content_hi}] and journeyTagline {en, hi}; and (b) ALWAYS-available derived decade figures computed from the cached collections/expenses, mirroring the frontend's Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/api/derive.ts decadeStats(): first year (DECADE_START_YEAR = 2017), latest year present, per-year total + contributor entry count (resold rows excluded, matching computeSummary), total collected across the whole span (grand total), grand contributor count, and best/peak year. This is the friendly EXTRA appended AFTER the existing core sections, never a replacement. STRICTLY cache-only (operate only on the passed-in `data`; add no fetch/D1) and bounded so it never crowds out existing sections or breaches the caps. Add the section to all three builders: summarizePortalData (general path), buildYearScopedContext (year path — a concise decade-context line still helps a year question situate itself, kept small), and buildFullContext. This feature is independent of FEAT-002 but they touch the same file; do FEAT-001 first.
steps: Setup: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH"; from repo root create a NEW branch off origin/main (e.g. `git fetch origin main && git checkout -b feat/chatbot-journey-language origin/main`); then `cd mgmt/server-render && npm ci && npm test` to confirm the 203-pass / 0-fail baseline before changing anything.

In mgmt/server-render/src/lib/publicData.js add a pure helper, e.g. `buildJourneySection(data)`, near the other helpers. It reads ONLY the passed-in `data`. Derived figures: compute the set of contribution years from collections; define DECADE_START_YEAR = 2017 (mirror the frontend constant, add a comment referencing Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/api/derive.ts). Determine firstYear = min(2017, earliest data year) is NOT correct — mirror the frontend: startYear = 2017, endYear = max(2017, latest data year). For each year in [startYear..endYear] compute total collected (sum of Amount) and contributor entry count EXCLUDING resold rows (c['Is Resell'] === 'TRUE' || === true), exactly like the existing top-contributors aggregation. Track grandTotal, grandContributors, and the best/peak year (highest total). Use the existing num() and inr() helpers for formatting (₹, en-IN).

In the same helper, when data.journeyEntries is a non-empty array, include a SHORT, bounded digest of the real story: the journeyTagline (prefer .en, fall back to .hi) if present, and a capped list (e.g. up to ~6 most relevant entries) of `year — title` using title_en (fall back to title_hi), keeping each entry to title only (NOT the full content_en/content_hi bodies) so the section stays bounded. Never dump every entry. If journeyEntries is absent/empty (older backend), emit ONLY the derived-figures narrative and that is the documented fallback approach. Defensive shapes throughout: any missing field yields ''/0, never throws.

Compose the section text with a clear header like 'JOURNEY / 10-YEAR STORY (the committee's decade of Chhath Puja, from {startYear} to {endYear} — use this to answer questions about hamari yatra / the journey / the decade / how far we have come):' followed by: the span line ({startYear} to {endYear}, N years), grand total collected across the span, grand contributor entries, best year (year + its total), a compact per-year growth line for the recent years (bounded — reuse the same ~6-year cap style the summary uses so tokens stay small), and the journey-story digest when present. Return '' only if there is genuinely no data (no years and no journeyEntries).

Wire the helper into summarizePortalData: append the journey section AFTER the existing sections (after the per-person + document blocks, before the final SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS cap/truncate step) so it is the friendly extra and is what gets trimmed first if the cap is hit. Do the same in buildFullContext (append after its existing sections, before the FULL_MAX_CHARS check that degrades to summary). In buildYearScopedContext, append a SMALL decade-context line (span + grand total + best year, without the full per-year growth list) after the year-scoped sections so a year question still situates itself in the decade — keep it minimal to respect the 6000-char cap on that path.

Preserve ALL existing behavior: do not alter year-scoped retrieval, per-person blocks, document links, ID->name resolution or the USER#### neutral-label degradation, the resell double-count note, or the NO_DEV_INSTRUCTIONS_LINE guardrail. The journey section adds text only; it must not change any existing line.

Add node:test unit tests in mgmt/server-render/test/publicChat.test.mjs (match the existing style — import summarizePortalData/buildFullContext, use a multi-year SAMPLE). Prove: (a) summarizePortalData emits the JOURNEY / 10-YEAR STORY header with the correct span (2017 -> latest), grand total across years, and best year for a multi-year fixture; (b) contributor counts in the journey figures EXCLUDE resold rows; (c) when data.journeyEntries + journeyTagline are present, the tagline and at least one `year — title` appear, and full content bodies are NOT dumped; (d) when journeyEntries is absent, the derived-figures narrative still appears (fallback path); (e) buildFullContext also contains the journey section; (f) the journey builder is CACHE-ONLY — stub globalThis.fetch to throw and assert summarizePortalData does not call it (mirror the existing 'CACHE-ONLY' tests); (g) on a large multi-year dataset the summary still stays <= 6100 chars (extend/mirror the existing cap test to confirm the journey section did not break the bound).
Run `npm test` and confirm all tests (existing 203 + new) pass with 0 failures.
acceptance_criteria: `cd mgmt/server-render && npm test` passes with 0 failures (baseline 203 + new journey tests).

summarizePortalData(multiYearData, 'hamari 10 saal ki yatra') contains a 'JOURNEY / 10-YEAR STORY' section stating the span from 2017 to the latest year, the grand total collected across all years, and the best/peak year.
The journey figures' contributor counts exclude resold rows (a resold row does not inflate the contributor count).
When data.journeyEntries and data.journeyTagline are present, the section includes the tagline and at least one `year — title`, and does NOT include the full content_en/content_hi bodies.
When data.journeyEntries is absent/empty, the derived-figures journey narrative is still present (no crash).
buildFullContext output also contains the journey section.
No new fetch/D1 call is added: the CACHE-ONLY test (fetch stubbed to throw) still passes.
The summary stays within SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS (<= 6100 in the existing cap test) and buildFullContext within FULL_MAX_CHARS on a large multi-year dataset.
All pre-existing tests remain green (year-scoped retrieval, per-person, document links, ID->name/neutral-label, resell note, NO_DEV_INSTRUCTIONS_LINE).
verification: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && cd mgmt/server-render && npm test  (all pass, 0 fail)
Confirm the new tests would fail if the journey section were removed (prove-first: the header/span/best-year assertions exercise the new code path).
review_v1_fixes: Addressed the NEEDS_CHANGES review (2026-09-18-210254-review.md). (1) MONEY-ONLY TOTAL: buildJourneySection/buildJourneyContextLine now sum only money rows via new isMoneyContribution() (Contribution Type '1' or '' => money; '2' material / '3' service => ₹0), mirroring derive.ts contributorsForYear/computeSummary. Extracted journeyYearFigures() so both builders share the exact logic; contributor COUNT is unchanged (any non-resold row with an ID, once per person) and verified. (2) SPAN END: endYear now = max(2017, latestDataYear, new Date().getFullYear()) so the span reaches the current calendar year even when cached data lags. Added latestJourneyYear() which unions collections+loans+committee Year values, mirroring availableYears(). (3) CONFLICTING TOTALS: the journey 'Recent years' line now reads 'Recent years (money contributions only; resold items and material/service excluded): ...' and the year-scoped decade line notes '(money contributions only)', disambiguating from the pre-existing resold-inclusive 'Year Y: collections' line. (4) TESTS: added 4 prove-first node:test cases — JOURNEY_MIXED_TYPES (material ₹10k + service ₹7k must NOT inflate the money grand total; asserts ₹1,000 not ₹18,000; both summary and year-scoped paths) and JOURNEY_STALE_DATA (latest data year 2020, loans/committee 2021; span must end at current calendar year, unions loans/committee). Updated 4 pre-existing journey tests that hardcoded the 2024 span end to compute the expected end year dynamically (max(2024, currentYear)). Verified prove-first: the 4 new tests + 3 updated tests fail against the pre-fix source and pass after. (5) MINOR: the English languageDirective variant now names the same offending scripts (Korean/Japanese/Chinese/Spanish) as the Hindi variant. Final: npm test => 221 tests, 221 pass, 0 fail (was 217). Constraints preserved: cache-only (CACHE-ONLY test green), caps respected (bound test green), buildContextForProvider signature unchanged, no Public/frontend-v6 or provider/model changes.
findings: Added buildJourneySection(data) + buildJourneyContextLine(data) helpers and a DECADE_START_YEAR=2017 constant to mgmt/server-render/src/lib/publicData.js. Wired the journey section into summarizePortalData and buildFullContext (appended after core sections, before caps) and a small decade-context line into buildYearScopedContext. Derived figures mirror derive.ts decadeStats: startYear=2017, endYear=max(2017, latest data year); per-year total + distinct-contributor count with resold rows EXCLUDED from BOTH the count and the money total (matching computeSummary/contributorsForYear). NOTE: the derived journey grand total is money-only/resold-excluded (e.g. a resold ₹500 row is NOT added), which is intentional to match the public 'Our Journey' page; this differs from the pre-existing per-year 'collections' line that includes resold amounts. Story digest surfaces journeyTagline (en, fall back hi) + up to 6 'year — title' lines (title_en fall back title_hi), never the content bodies. Cache-only preserved (no fetch/D1). Added 9 node:test cases in test/publicChat.test.mjs. Final: cd mgmt/server-render && npm test => 212 tests, 212 pass, 0 fail (baseline 203 + 9 new). Committed on branch feat/chatbot-journey-language (not pushed). Did not touch Public/frontend-v6 or provider/model config.
